title: SDK first-run onboarding: zero to first command
desc: Step-by-step guide for a brand-new customer: GitHub account setup through running their first wkappbot command. Written from customer perspective. No assumed knowledge of the codebase.
steps: PREREQUISITE: GitHub account required (free). Install gh CLI: winget install GitHub.cli then gh auth login. This is the license auth infra -- without it wkappbot runs in Free tier only.

SETUP SCRIPT (setup.ps1): idempotent first-run script distributed with SDK. Creates .wkappbot/config.json from template, prompts Slack webhook token, adds wkappbot bin\ to PATH, runs 'wkappbot eye tick' to verify Eye starts. Re-running is safe -- detects already-configured state and skips. Reduces support tickets from PATH/config issues.

DIAGNOSTICS: 'wkappbot diagnostics' subcommand dumps env report -- OS version, wkappbot version, install path, PATH check, Eye status (running/stopped), license tier, last 5 errors from errors.jsonl. Include output in every support ticket. Reduces back-and-forth with support.

requirements.expect: returns UI element tree or clear error if notepad not running
